proposed.text: A 22 m building has a 28 m by 28 m footprint and measured natural frequency of 1.3 Hz. Which source-safe classification is correct?

options.text: Use a general all-heights wind procedure; it is not low-rise because 22 m > 18 m, and it is rigid because 1.3 Hz >= 1.0 Hz.
Use the low-rise envelope procedure because the plan is square.
Treat it as flexible because every building over 18 m is flexible.
Ignore wind classification because exposure controls everything.

rationale.correct: The building fails the 18 m low-rise height criterion. A frequency of 1.3 Hz is greater than or equal to 1.0 Hz, which is rigid under the checked definition.
